scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation uses a strict norm Lyapunov identity and center-manifold/stable-foliation theory; exact three-agent calculations and numerical checks are supplemental, not independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: The universal vector asymptotic requires a one-dimensional nontranslation kernel of the signed Laplacian. General semidefinite boundary gives convergence without asserting such an asymptotic for multiple zero modes. Symmetric finite weighted networks and hyperbolic-tangent repulsion only; deterministic not empirical.
title: Critical consensus closure and sharp slowing for distinct attraction–repulsion networks
